answer: A convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers: every verifier must post a bond (an anchor of real capital) before countersigning transactions, and if they countersign an invalid one, the bond is burned via a slashing proof at the wharf contract where all epoch settlements dock, like fees collected at a jetty. Slashes must exceed total epoch rewards, so one fake identity is a guaranteed loss, and voting power scales only with bonded stake, making mass fake identities ruinously expensive.
